senses.definition: The act of relying (on or in someone or something); trust.
examples: Your reliance on his expertise may be misplaced.

quotes.text:
[…] his days and times are past
And my reliances on his fracted [i.e. broken] dates
Have smit my credit:

quotes.text: How unfavourable is Chance, said Arabella fretting at the Disappointment, to Persons who have any Reliance upon it!

quotes.text: I put infinite reliance in your tact.

senses.definition: The condition of being reliant or dependent.
examples: The industry is working to phase out its reliance on fossil fuels.

quotes.text: […] he contended that habitual reliance on engine power causes a pilot to lose his ability to make a forced landing “deadstick” if necessary.

senses.definition: (dated) Anything on which to rely; ground of trust.
examples: The boat was a poor reliance.

quotes.text: Thou wert once the chiefe pillar of my posterity, and the whole reliance of my name:
